description: Resolve a dependency worklist without cycle detection or a work limit.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary dependency resolution software, not an evolutionary algorithm. The source performs dependency resolution only; no candidate population, candidate fitness pipeline, or offspring/replacement lifecycle exists. The operation has no effective bound or shutdown path. Policy basis: The existing resource policy treats a potentially unbounded loop without a hard-unbounded marker as requiring review, yielding CONDITIONALLY_SAFE at medium risk.
